title: Refactor report
description: The maintenance refactor agent's report per chosen cleanup item. Shown to the owner in the PR; reviewers and the judge check the diff, not this report.

status.description: done: applied in full. partial: part of it (say what is left). not-done: left alone (say why).

summary.description: What you changed for this item, in plain words.

claudeMd.description: What you changed in CLAUDE.md and why, or null when nothing.
